evals.prompt: Create a premium LinkedIn single-image post in Adolfo's brand style about dashboards not being the transformation.
evals.expected_output: A publishable visual concept or asset using the Adolfo palette, executive mining style, clear CTA, and mobile-legible text.
assertions: Uses Graphite, Mineral White, Copper, and Deep Teal appropriately
Includes a dominant headline and minimal body copy
Uses a signal-to-action or decision-flow motif
Avoids generic influencer or SaaS styling
Is suitable for LinkedIn mobile viewing

evals.prompt: Create a 7-slide LinkedIn PDF carousel using the Adolfo brand system for mining predictive maintenance readiness.
evals.expected_output: A carousel plan or asset with 1080x1350 pages, one idea per slide, strong first-slide hook, and final CTA.
assertions: Each slide has one clear idea

evals.prompt: Combine linkedin-service-offer-ads and adolfo-linkedin-brand-system to create a publishable GoalPraxis lead magnet.
evals.expected_output: A lead-magnet concept or asset with service-offer CTA, checklist utility, and Adolfo/GoalPraxis visual style.
assertions: Combines offer strategy with visual brand rules
